responsibility: Implements the Go frontend type system, including canonical and named type construction, alias and forward-declaration handling, verification, identity/comparability/hash properties, method attachment, reflection/type-descriptor generation, export/import support, and conversion of Go types to backend `Btype` representations. It is the core owner of Go type semantics and of the bridges from frontend type objects to runtime metadata and backend layout information.
same_name_distinction: Implements the type-system behavior declared in `types.h`, including alias/forward-resolution, verification, method attachment, reflection/export logic, and backend type construction. Unlike `types.h`, it contains the semantic algorithms and conversions for type objects rather than the type class definitions and constants.
